comparisons.peer_summary: International sales accounted for 66% of net revenue in 2024 (65% in 2023) and are expected to remain significant; substantially all sales transactions are denominated in U.S. dollars.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Intel disclose details regarding the nature and geographic scope of their sales transactions. While Intel focuses on the contractual mechanisms (purchase order acknowledgments with standard terms and indemnities) used to finalize sales, AMD highlights the geographic distribution (international vs. domestic) and currency denomination of those same sales. Both disclosures confirm that Intel operates with standard contractual terms for its sales and that AMD conducts a significant volume of its sales internationally, though AMD notes that substantially all transactions are denominated in U.S. dollars, aligning with Intel's description of standard terms covering pricing in U.S. context.

sentences.text: Sales of our products are frequently made via purchase order acknowledgments that contain standard terms and conditions covering matters such as pricing, payment terms, and warranties, as well as indemnities for issues specific to our products, such as patent and copyright indemnities.
Substantially all of our sales transactions are denominated in U.S. dollars.
